fields.name: Whisper Ultra No Gap No Leaks XL+ – 15 Pads
fields.description: XL+ sanitary pads with an absorbent core and extended coverage for heavy-flow days.

fields.name: Stayfree Secure Nights XXL – 18 Pads

fields.name: Sofy Bodyfit Pro XL – 18 Pads

fields.name: Nua Complete Comfort XL+ – 12 Pads
fields.description: Ultra-thin sanitary pads with a soft breathable top layer and wider back coverage.

fields.name: Pee Safe Aloe Vera Panty Liners
fields.description: Pee Safe Aloe Vera Panty Liners are designed for everyday freshness and light discharge protection. Their soft and comfortable design helps you feel fresh throughout the day. Suitable for daily use.

fields.name: Pee Safe Reusable Menstrual Cup
fields.description: Pee Safe Reusable Menstrual Cup is designed to collect menstrual flow during periods. Its reusable design offers an alternative to disposable period products. Follow the product instructions for correct insertion, cleaning and sterilization.

fields.name: Stayfree o.b Pro Comfort Regular – 20 Count
fields.description: Stayfree o.b Pro Comfort Regular Tampons are designed for menstrual flow absorption with a compact and discreet design. They offer a convenient alternative to external period products. Always follow the usage and replacement instructions on the package.

fields.name: Sirona Pad-Free Menstrual Cup – Medium
fields.description: Sirona Menstrual Cup is a reusable period care product designed to collect menstrual flow. It provides a reusable alternative to disposable sanitary products. Clean and sterilize the cup according to the manufacturer's instructions before and after use.

fields.name: Stayfree o.b Pro Comfort Super – 10 Count
fields.description: Stayfree o.b Pro Comfort Super Tampons are designed to absorb menstrual flow during periods. Their compact design offers a discreet period care option. Choose the absorbency level suitable for your flow and follow the package instructions.

fields.name: Sirona Heavy Flow Tampons – 20 Count
fields.description: Sirona Heavy Flow Tampons are designed for menstrual flow absorption on heavier flow days. Their compact design makes them convenient to carry and use. Follow the package instructions and change at the recommended intervals.

fields.name: Sirona Hygienic Menstrual Cup Wash – 100 ml
fields.description: Sirona Menstrual Cup Wash is designed for cleaning reusable menstrual cups. It helps maintain cup hygiene as part of your period care routine. Use according to the manufacturer's instructions.

fields.name: Apollo Pharmacy Women's Intimate Wipes – 30 Count
fields.description: Apollo Pharmacy Women's Intimate Wipes are designed for convenient external intimate hygiene and freshness. Their portable pack makes them easy to carry while travelling or during daily routines. For external use only.

fields.name: Nua Cramp Comfort Heat Patch – Pack of 3
fields.description: Nua Cramp Comfort Heat Patches are designed to provide soothing warmth during period discomfort. These self-heating patches are convenient to carry and use as part of your monthly comfort routine. Follow the instructions on the packaging.

fields.name: Nua Cramp Relief Roll-On – 40 ml
fields.description: Nua Cramp Relief Roll-On is a convenient topical product designed for period discomfort. Its compact 40 ml packaging makes it easy to carry and apply to the areas mentioned on the product label. Use as directed by the manufacturer.

fields.name: Sirona Cute Teddy Electric Hot Water Bag
fields.description: Sirona Cute Teddy Electric Hot Water Bag provides comforting warmth for period cramps and muscle discomfort. Its soft teddy design, portable construction and automatic shut-off feature make it a convenient heat therapy accessory. Follow the charging and safety instructions before use.

fields.name: Sirona Feminine Pain Relief Patch – Pack of 5
fields.description: Sirona Feminine Pain Relief Patches are designed for targeted comfort during period cramps and lower back discomfort. The herbal formula includes menthol and eucalyptus and provides a cooling sensation. Apply according to the manufacturer's instructions.

fields.name: Sirona Electric Menstrual Cup Sterilizer
fields.description: Sirona Electric Menstrual Cup Sterilizer is designed to help maintain menstrual cup hygiene through steam sterilization. Its compact design makes it suitable for home use. Follow the manufacturer's instructions for safe operation and cleaning.

fields.name: Sirona Reusable Period Panty – Size L
fields.description: Sirona Reusable Period Panty is designed for comfortable menstrual protection with an absorbent and leak-resistant inner layer. Its breathable fabric and washable construction make it a reusable alternative to disposable period products. Wash and care according to the label instructions.

fields.name: Sirona Sanitary Disposal Bags – Pack of 45
fields.description: Sirona Sanitary Disposal Bags are designed for hygienic and discreet disposal of used sanitary pads and other menstrual waste. Their odour-concealing and leak-resistant design makes them convenient for home and travel use. Pack contains 45 disposal bags.

fields.name: Nua Gentle Intimate Wash – 100 ml
fields.description: Nua Gentle Intimate Wash is designed for external intimate hygiene and everyday freshness. Its foaming formula is made for gentle cleansing and comes in a convenient 100 ml bottle. Use externally as directed on the product label.

fields.name: Nua Comfort Period Panties – Pack of 5
fields.description: Nua Comfort Period Panties are disposable menstrual underwear designed for comfortable period protection. Their panty-style fit offers convenient coverage during periods. Pack contains five disposable panties. Select the correct size according to the packaging.

fields.name: Sirona Disposable Period Panties – Pack of 10
fields.description: Sirona Disposable Period Panties are designed for convenient menstrual protection during the day and night. Their absorbent construction and snug fit help provide coverage during period days. Pack contains ten disposable panties. Choose the correct size before use.

fields.name: Anandi 100% Organic Cotton Panty Liners – 40 Count
fields.description: Anandi 100% Organic Cotton Panty Liners feature a soft organic cotton top layer and breathable plant-based backsheet. These ultra-thin liners are designed for everyday freshness, light discharge and spotting. Individually wrapped for convenient use.

fields.name: Donna Organic Menstrual Cup – Large
fields.description: Donna Organic Menstrual Cup is a reusable period care product designed to collect menstrual flow. Its flexible cup design offers an alternative to disposable sanitary products. Follow the manufacturer's instructions for insertion, removal, cleaning and sterilization.

fields.name: Amrutanjan Comfy Snug Fit Sanitary Pads Dry XL – 18 Pads
fields.description: Amrutanjan Comfy Snug Fit Dry XL Sanitary Pads are designed for menstrual flow absorption and comfortable protection. Their extra-long 280 mm design, larger wings and anti-leak system provide additional coverage during heavy flow days. Pack contains 18 pads.

fields.name: Everteen Period Care Soft Top Layer Sanitary Pads – 40 Count
fields.description: Everteen Period Care Sanitary Pads are designed to provide comfortable menstrual protection with a soft top layer. Their absorbent construction helps manage menstrual flow and offers convenient everyday period care. Pack contains 40 pads.

fields.name: Plush 100% U.S. Pure Cotton Daily Panty Liner – 20 Count
fields.description: Plush 100% U.S. Pure Cotton Daily Panty Liners feature a soft cotton top sheet and breathable backsheet. Their lightweight design provides everyday freshness and helps absorb light discharge and spotting. Fragrance-free and suitable for daily intimate hygiene.

fields.name: Securteen Menstrual Cup – Large, 30 ml
fields.description: Securteen Menstrual Cup is made from medical-grade silicone and designed to collect menstrual flow. Its reusable construction offers a pad-free period care alternative. The large variant has a 30 ml capacity. Follow the product instructions for proper use and sterilization.

fields.name: QNIX Boxer Brief Period Underwear – XL Black
fields.description: QNIX Boxer Brief Period Underwear is designed to provide menstrual protection in a comfortable boxer-style fit. Its absorbent construction offers an alternative to disposable period products. This black XL variant is suitable for reusable period care. Follow the garment washing instructions.

fields.name: Sirona Premium Applicator Super Plus Heavy Flow Tampons – 16 Count
fields.description: Sirona Premium Applicator Super Plus Tampons are designed for menstrual flow absorption on heavy flow days. Their applicator design supports convenient insertion and comfortable use. Pack contains 16 tampons. Follow the instructions and recommended replacement intervals.

fields.name: Hi Life Flow Easy Organic Pad with Honeycomb LeakLock – 30 Pads
fields.description: Hi Life Flow Easy Organic Pads feature a honeycomb-style LeakLock design for menstrual flow absorption. Their organic-focused period care design provides comfortable coverage and helps manage leakage. Pack contains 30 pads.

fields.name: Be Me Organic Sanitary Pads with Disposal Pouches – 30 Pads
fields.description: Be Me Organic Sanitary Pads are designed for moderate to heavy menstrual flow protection. Their soft organic cotton-focused construction offers comfortable coverage, while individual disposal pouches make used-pad disposal more convenient and discreet. Pack contains 30 pads.

fields.name: Stayfree Dry-Max All Night Ultra-Dry – 42 Pads
fields.description: Stayfree Dry-Max All Night Ultra-Dry Sanitary Pads are designed for overnight menstrual protection. Their extra-long and extra-wide design provides extended coverage, while Super Lock Pockets help absorb and lock in menstrual flow. Individually wrapped for convenient use.

fields.name: Nua All Night Comfort Sanitary Pads XXXL – 18 Pads
fields.description: Nua All Night Comfort XXXL Sanitary Pads are designed for overnight use and heavy menstrual flow. Their extra-long 400 mm design provides extended coverage and comfortable protection during sleep. Pack contains 18 pads.

fields.name: Sofy Anti Bacteria Sanitary Pads XL – 14 Pads
fields.description: Sofy Anti Bacteria Sanitary Pads XL are designed for comfortable menstrual protection with an antibacterial sheet featuring Herbal Shield technology. Their Comfy Dry Cover helps maintain dryness and comfort during periods. Pack contains 14 XL pads.

fields.name: Bella Softi Wings Classic Sanitary Pads – 15 Pads
fields.description: Bella Softi Wings Classic Sanitary Pads are designed to provide comfortable protection during menstrual periods. Their soft surface and side wings help keep the pad securely positioned and provide coverage against leakage. Pack contains 15 pads.

fields.name: Menarche 100% Organic Cotton Tampons – Regular Flow, 20 Count
fields.description: Menarche 100% Organic Cotton Tampons are made with highly absorbent soft cotton fibres for menstrual flow management. Their smooth rounded tip and anti-slip grip are designed for convenient insertion. Suitable for regular flow days. Pack contains 20 tampons.

fields.name: Zoy Reusable Menstrual Cup – Small, BPA Free
fields.description: Zoy Reusable Menstrual Cup is a BPA-free period care product designed to collect menstrual flow. Its flexible reusable design offers an alternative to disposable sanitary products. Clean and sterilize according to the manufacturer's instructions before and after use.

fields.name: Imasafe Reusable Menstrual Cup – Black Medium
fields.description: Imasafe Reusable Menstrual Cup is made from 100% medical-grade liquid silicone. Its flexible design is intended to collect menstrual flow and provide a reusable alternative to disposable period products. Follow the manufacturer's instructions for correct use and sterilization.

fields.name: Sirona Small Pro Super Soft Reusable Menstrual Cup
fields.description: Sirona Small Pro Super Soft Menstrual Cup is a reusable silicone cup designed to collect menstrual flow rather than absorb it. Its soft and flexible construction offers a comfortable period care alternative. Follow the product instructions for insertion, removal, cleaning and sterilization.

fields.name: Yoni Organic Cotton Applicator Tampons – Regular, 16 Count
fields.description: Yoni Organic Cotton Applicator Tampons are made with certified organic cotton, including the string. Their cardboard applicator is designed for convenient insertion, while the absorbent cotton core helps manage menstrual flow. Pack contains 16 regular-flow tampons.

fields.name: iCare Hygienic Reusable Menstrual Cup – Large
fields.description: iCare Hygienic Reusable Menstrual Cup is made from soft medical-grade silicone. Its flexible and foldable design is intended to collect menstrual flow and provide reusable period protection. Clean and sterilize according to the manufacturer's instructions.
